intro: Alabama runs its elections county by county, through the probate judge, the sheriff, the circuit clerk and the county board of registrars, with the Secretary of State overseeing the state.

id_rule.text: Bring a valid photo ID, such as an Alabama driver's license or other approved photo ID. If you do not have one, you can get a free Alabama photo voter ID, or you can vote if two election officials positively identify you and you sign an affidavit.

dates.detail: Your county absentee election manager must have your mailed application by this date. Alabama requires a reason to vote absentee, such as being away from your county on Election Day or having a disability or illness.
